planned_same_model_baseline.model: same provider/model/settings as candidate; select at evaluation time
planned_same_model_baseline.resources: same initial task state, tools, authorized evidence, total HTTP/cost and stop limits
planned_same_model_baseline.workflow: fixed read-goal/read-application when applicable, then model selection; compare to dynamic graph without withholding useful evidence
planned_same_model_baseline.accounting: all roles/retries/judges count; new stage authorization required; no old ledger reset

smoke_rules: read goal; respect explicit stop; clarify multiple applications; prefer evidenced retest, otherwise first server action; JD training or confirmed-direction research; clarify unknown direction
comparison: retain every attempt and task pairing; do not use scripted results to claim multi-agent or LLM quality gains
